description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the trophy hall: a long low stone hall with a wooden shingle roof and an open front, the inner walls hung with mounted beast heads, antlers, a grey wolf pelt and big curved fangs, a boar head over the door
